content:
The Final Conference of the C2Ø – Construction to Zero project, the Decarbonisation Roadmap for the construction supply chain and associated industrial activities, will take place on 30 October.

📅 30 October | ⏰ 2:00pm | 📍 CCB Congress Centre – Lisbon

The Final Conference will be the moment to present the results obtained throughout the project's execution, with the main focus on the Roadmap, which will compile the measures for the decarbonisation of the targeted industries: manufacture of other carpentry products for construction; manufacture of concrete products for construction; manufacture of ready-mixed concrete; manufacture of mortars; and manufacture of bituminous mixtures.

Registration is free of charge, but mandatory, and is already available here .

As a reminder, C2Ø – Construction to Zero is a joint project of PTPC – Plataforma Tecnológica Portuguesa da Construção and ATIC – Associação Portuguesa de Cimento, with the support of 3drivers and BUILT CoLAB, and is co-financed by the European Union – NextGenerationEU, under the PRR – Recovery and Resilience Plan.
